channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — November 19, 2026
item.description:
Today's 52 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x (563,861 ⭐) — Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.
  2. public-apis/public-apis (500,220 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  3. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (459,337 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  4. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (372,362 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  5. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (338,550 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  6. vinta/awesome-python (335,806 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  7. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (290,020 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  8. torvalds/linux (256,049 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
  9. react/react (252,768 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
  10. TheAlgorithms/Python (226,303 ⭐) — All Algorithms implemented in Python
